subject: maths
question: What will be the amount due on Rs. 25,000 in 2 years when the rate of interest in successive years is 12% and 10% per annum respectively (interest is compounding annually)?
solution:
**Given**

Principal = Rs. 25,000

Rate of interest for the first year = 12%

Rate of interest for the second year = 10%

**Concept:**

Compound interest formula (A = P × (1 + r/n)⁽ⁿt⁾), where A is the amount, P is the principal, r is the rate of interest, n is the number of times the interest is compounded per year, and t is the time in years.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount after first year = 25000 × (1 + 12/100) = Rs. 28000

⇒ Amount after second year = 28000 × (1 + 10/100) = Rs. 30800

**Hence, the amount due after 2 years is Rs. 30,800.**
